title: Nf Opt Round4 Crt
objective: Batch modified Round-4 modular Krylov and CRT reconstruction with exact bounds and annihilation certificates, preserving dynamic fallback and vector010 exactness

handoff.summary: Implemented source-transparent varying-prime Krylov batches, exact two-level CRT, theorem-sized reconstruction and annihilation certificates, direct characteristic recurrence, packed power-basis/scalar arithmetic, moderate-degree exact quotient solving, and delayed safe word-prime reductions. Round-4 results now retain a compact proof envelope binding canonical input/output HNFs, exact index and discriminants, Ford-Letard e*f=n, all 24 minimal-polynomial events, and all 17 quotient multiply-backs. Vector010 construction is 25.67s and compact independent verification is 2.05s, down from 56-76s construction and 29.5s verification; exact HNF/index/discriminant, 67 characteristic calls, 24 modular calls, 3936 primes, and e=16/f=2 remain certified.
risks: The 37ms PARI nfbasis reference means 25.67s construction is still about 700x slower; incremental host-object cleanup cannot satisfy the final gate.
The final construction profile is modular characteristic 24 calls/5.87s, exact quotient 17/4.45s, and residue refinement 2/13.54s inclusive; a packed whole-state algorithmic boundary is required.
The delayed-reduction source adds 915 bytes before generated registry overhead; the integration lane owns the final package-budget adjustment and full native/platform suite.
next_steps: Integrate c6b6be63 for the public field-analysis discriminant/closure ABI and 84785c8c for safe delayed word-prime reductions.
The nf-opt-round4-native-state lane owns the packed whole residue-refinement/type state machine, retaining this lane's characteristic and quotient proof-event schemas.
Register focused tests and benchmarks centrally, make one evidence-backed package-budget adjustment, then run pnpm test:native and pnpm architecture:check on the integrated tree.
